evidence: Wikipedia's article on Prince lists James Brown first among the funk musicians who influenced him, and records Miles Davis describing Prince as a blend of James Brown, Jimi Hendrix, Marvin Gaye, Sly Stone and Little Richard.

earlier.title: Get Up (I Feel Like Being a) Sex Machine

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Listen for the rhythm guitar: a short, choppy chord repeated on the beat, the bass locked to the kick drum, and every instrument playing a small part of one groove. Prince plays all of it himself, but the plan is Brown's.

explanation: James Brown's tight, rhythm-first funk was one of Prince's biggest influences, and on his early records Prince played the whole funk band himself. It is held at consensus: the influence is listed by Wikipedia and named by Miles Davis, but no direct statement by Prince was read.
